ui_bugs.issue: Keypad concatenates raw digits to existing auto-filled amount without decimal handling. Toggling 'Huur' auto-fills SRD 5000.00 — typing '1','0','0' on keypad produces literal string '5000.00100' instead of treating new digits as fresh entry or properly appending pre-decimal. Display value resets when checklist item is toggled off, so it's recoverable, but UX is confusing.

Spec internally contradictory but agent_to_agent_context_note says 'Welcome screen has NO footer (intentional)'. Footer IS currently visible on Welcome (verified in screenshot — 'SuriRent N.V.' + Beheerder + Uit shown). Either the note is stale or the footer needs to be conditionally hidden on the Welcome step. Confirm with main agent which is intended.

issues: Card title displays 'HUIS HUIS 7A' (duplicate 'HUIS' prefix). Likely the loop prepends 'HUIS' and the apartment number stored in DB is already 'HUIS 7A'. Visible in screenshot for all 4 cards. Consider stripping leading 'HUIS' from number before render or storing only the suffix.

rca of the issue: Keypad concat bug RCA: PaySelect likely uses single state amount as string and onKeypadDigit does setAmount(prev => prev + digit). When checklist toggle pre-fills 5000.00 the next digit press concatenates instead of resetting. Fix: maintain a typingStarted boolean that resets amount to '' on first keypad press after a checklist toggle, or restrict keypad to integer cents and disable while checklist is active. Duplicate HUIS prefix RCA: ApartmentSelect renders `HUIS {a.number}` but DB stored numbers already include 'HUIS' prefix (HUIS 7A, HUIS 7B, etc.). Either change render template to `{a.number}` or normalize stored numbers via migration.
